audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks 'Twofold Hunt (Blink)', which is not an Aurora ability, and describes it as 'her escape'.
audit.why: Her Q is Twofold Hex (9s at rank 1, 900 range, a missile that curses and is recast to drag the curses back). Her escape and keg-denial tool is a different ability: Across the Veil (W, 22s at rank 1, 700 range) — a leap that leaves her invisible with bonus move speed. The full layer has fused the two into one invented name, so the reader tracks a 9s poke cooldown while thinking it is a 22s escape.
audit.corrected: Split them: Twofold Hex is the 9s poke, Across the Veil is the 22s dash-and-invisibility that denies your kegs and dodges detonations. Applied across tldr, dosFull, dontsFull, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Gangplank levels 2-3 and call 4-5 and 6 even; the packet chart and their own text say Aurora owns levels 3 through 6.
audit.why: whys[2] ends 'concede the wave', whys[3] ends 'survive and farm', whys[4] says respect her hardest all-in — three Aurora rows written as if they were yours. whys[1] says trade nothing into her dash, which is Skill, not Gangplank. The 49.43% win rate matches a lane you lose before your item spike.
audit.corrected: Level 2 = Skill, Level 3 / Levels 4-5 / Level 6 = Aurora, first item and 2+ items stay Gangplank. One atomic group across both layers, ratings moved with it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes lists 'Twofold Hunt online' as her spike and phases[4].why never names her ultimate.
audit.why: Her spikes are the Twofold Hex recast (missing-health poke) from level 3, and Between Worlds at 6 (140/120/100s) which walls the lane, slows and lets her cross the zone. Yours are Sheen/Essence Reaver, where an empowered Parrrley detonating a chain finally out-bursts her poke, and 2+ items where the chain kills an AP frame outright.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Between Worlds with its 140s cooldown and pairs it with Across the Veil's detonation-dodging.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer calls for Grievous Wounds, and the itemization line lists no anti-heal for this matchup.
audit.why: Spirit Abjuration heals her off the spirits her spells and attacks exorcise, which is exactly the healing that undoes a poke-trade pattern.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now states the passive heal and calls for Grievous Wounds.

edits.after: Build MR, survive the Twofold Hex poke, flip it on Sheen. Bait Across the Veil first.

notes: All three packet suspectNames are false positives (Between Worlds, Cannon Barrage, Twofold Hex are all correct). The fabricated 'Twofold Hunt' survives in winCon, enemyWin, ahead, loading, focus.text (19 chars, under the applier's 25-char floor), breakdown.early/mid/feeding/difficulty/trading/spikes and report[1]/[3]/[9]/[10]/[12]/[13] — a champion-level search-and-replace to 'Across the Veil' is needed there. The content layer's claim that Aurora is untargetable while crossing her Between Worlds zone is not in Riot's text (it says she teleports from one side to the other), so I left it alone and logged it as unverified.
